relevant_laws.quote: Every vehicle driven upon a divided highway must be driven only upon the right-hand roadway and must not be driven over, across or within any dividing space, barrier or section or make any left turn, semicircular turn or U-turn, except through an opening in the barrier or dividing section or space or at a crossover or intersection established by a public authority.
notes: Establish highway and conventional-vehicle scope, opposing roadways and roadway boundaries excluding shoulders.
Establish statutory highway and vehicle scope and opposing roadways.
Observe the complete maneuver, including any multiple movements, and preserve public-authority establishment as a separate administrative fact where relevant.
Preserve exception scope and distinguish physical opening facts from any public-authority establishment claim.
Provide explicit barrier and opening extents with sufficient maneuvering space.
Realize explicit barrier extents and an opening wide enough for the selected vehicle's U-turn route; do not place the barrier across that opening.
Retain every movement, initial and final directions, and the complete footprint trajectory.
